item.text: The schema shows there's already a budget vs actual table. Let me query it directly to see which heads are over budget.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT * FROM expense_vouchers_2025_budget_vs_actual WHERE \\\"Actual (Apr-Sep)\\\" > \\\"Budget (FY25-26)\\\" ORDER BY (\\\"Actual (Apr-Sep)\\\" - \\\"Budget (FY25-26)\\\") DESC\""

/bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT * FROM expense_vouchers_2025_budget_vs_actual WHERE \\\"Actual (Apr-Sep)\\\" > \\\"Budget (FY25-26)\\\" ORDER BY (\\\"Actual (Apr-Sep)\\\" - \\\"Budget (FY25-26)\\\") DESC\""
